scenarios.faculty_interpretation_as_reported: The response is directionally and temporally coherent, although the pressure increase is at the low end of what would ideally be expected after crystalloid and packed red cells. Given ongoing hemorrhage, the trajectory is acceptable for development.
Untreated deterioration is coherent. Treatment response begins at an appropriate time and is directionally correct. Magnitude is modest / low-end plausible. Acceptable for development.
Delayed deterioration and recovery are coherent. Pressure response is modest but remains plausible with ongoing hemorrhage. Acceptable for development.

Slow crystalloid infusion appropriately attenuates deterioration without stabilizing the patient. Hypotension continues to worsen despite completion of the litre. No further recalibration is needed for this scenario.
